Description: Born on the 28th of June 2008 in Malta, I’ve always lived at the intersection of two passions: animals and technology. Hocus Pets grew out of that mix, a place where my love for pets meets my fascination with software, hardware, and building things from the ground up. I’m the one who designed and developed the entire Hocus Pets website from scratch, turning ideas into a fully working platform through countless hours of coding, testing, and refining. For me, tech isn’t just a skill, it’s a way to create experiences that make life better for pets and the people who love them. As a co‑founder, I’m driven by curiosity, creativity, and a genuine commitment to building something meaningful in the pet world. Hocus Pets is more than a project; it’s the start of a journey I’ve been preparing for my whole life.

I was born on the 8th of March 2008 in Malta, and for as long as I can remember, two things have always been a big part of my life: pets and hairdressing. I’ve always loved taking care of animals, and I’ve always had a passion for creativity and style, whether it’s hair, or anything that lets me express myself. As a co‑founder of Hocus Pets, I bring that same creativity, care, and attention to detail into everything I do. I love being part of a project that’s built around helping pets and the people who love them. My role is all about adding warmth, personality, and a human touch to the brand, making sure Hocus Pets feels welcoming, friendly, and full of heart. Hocus Pets is more than just a business to me, it’s a place where my passions come together, and I’m proud to help shape its journey.
